title: neotinea lactea f. hanrii
intro: Neotinea lactea f. hanrii, commonly known as the Hanrii's Neotinea or the Hanrii's Dactylorhiza, is a species of orchid known for its unique characteristics. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Neotinea lactea f. hanrii are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are known for their anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. However, more research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic potential and bioactive constituents of Neotinea lactea f. hanrii.
